notes.title: Gods Will Fall - DLC Part 3 "Anord Rith + God of Chaos" available now!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Gods Will Fall - DLC Part 3 available now![/b][/h1]
Slumbering in an upturned world devoid of time or place lies Anord Rith, a forgotten lord of the ancient age of chaos. Formed of three monstrous greatworms, she’s an adversary that's unpredictable with her multi-pronged attack style.

In this final installment from the Valley of the Dormant Gods step, into the realm of Chaos where the stakes constantly change, and face a creature unlike anything that's come before.

[h2][b]Part 3 includes:[/b][/h2]
An Unprecendented New Realm
Enter the mind-bending realm of chaos, home to a new god - Anord Rith

[h2][b]Three New Items:[/b][/h2]
Mead Horn, Life Rune, Whetstone

[h2][b]Three New Skills:[/b][/h2]
Precision Striker, Best Foot Forward, Anger of the Clans

Valley of the Dormant Gods, Part 3 is automatically available for those who own the Valiant Edition of Gods Will Fall.

[previewyoutube=JghgvOAaRzU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Valley of the Dormant Gods - Gortainh the God of Pain DLC
notes.content:
[h1]LET THE PAIN REIGN! DLC 2 OUT NOW![/h1]
Gortainh has been released from his sleeping state. Here to put our heroic God Slayers through their paces once again! Are you up for the challenge?!!!!

[h2]A New Realm Awaits[/h2]
A punishing new abyssal realm, with new vassals leads you to a terrifying new god for you to slay - Gortainh, the God of Pain.

[h2]A New Weapon Class[/h2]
Your brave party is now bolstered with a new class of hero - The Javelineer. A master of ranged combat, they wield a cluster of short spears, able to hurl and retrieve them in a lethal display of skill. Combine this with new skills and items, and the fires of vengeance burn bright for your warriors.

[h2]Three New Items[/h2]
Call Of Morrigan, Lightning Rod, Spore Powder

[h2]Two New Skills[/h2]
Second Chance, Destroyer

[previewyoutube=BtrQfKB5wMQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Valley of the Dormant Gods, Part 2 is the second of three Gods Will Fall DLC episodes. Part 2 will automatically available for those who own the Valiant Edition of Gods Will Fall.

notes.title: Gods Will Fall DLC Roadmap
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We want to share our thanks from the entire Gods Will Fall team to all of you for your overwhelming support and encouragement you’ve shared with us since we first announced Gods Will Fall in November 2020.

We’ve seen some unbelievably skilled play-throughs, hard-won victories, and bitter defeats against the diabolical gods and we hear you asking for more!


We’ve got an incredible year ahead with Gods Will Fall and we’re excited to unveil our DLC roadmap, packed full of details for the upcoming DLC: [b]Valley of the Dormant Gods[/b], alongside the free DLC: [b]The Dolmen Depths[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206104/d6eeb510a1147ea10edc29e51b0c5ff36cc6ff70.png[/img]
[h1]The Valley of the Dormant Gods[/h1]
Releasing in stages across Q2 and Q3 this year, each DLC installment will include a full new level and god encounter, plus new items, skills, and new warrior cosmetic items.

New weapon classes will also be included in each of the first two installments of the DLC and there will also be some new features added to the Overworld.

Gods Will Fall will automatically update for those who own the [url=https://godswillfall.com/news/official-gameplay-trailer-pre-order-bonus-valiant-edition-revealed]Valiant Edition[/url]. 


In addition to this, The Dolmen Depths will be released completely free for all via a patch in Q2.

[h1]The Dolmen Depths[/h1]
Delve into a mysterious underworld of the Dolmen Depths and fight to bring a long-lost warrior back from the beyond and into your party.

This free DLC will introduce a new, procedurally generated dungeon environment, brimming with enemies, desperate to keep the dead where they belong! 


For more information on Gods Will Fall and to stay up to date with all the latest news, follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/GodsWillFallGame/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Gods_Will_Fall]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/godswillfallgame/]Instagram[/url], or visit our [url=https://godswillfall.com/]website[/url] to sign-up to our newsletter.

notes.title: February PC Patch
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’ve been working hard to improve Gods Will Fall for you and we really appreciate your continued support with reporting any issues you’ve experienced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206104/01c1630422c10b94bef316ee25881425b1e15410.png[/img]

Our February PC Patch has now gone live, addressing some of the issues you’ve raised to us since launch.
Read on for the full patch details:

[b]Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*] Achievements have now been enabled on PC platforms, as they were absent from the launch of Gods Will Fall, bringing them to parity with most console platforms.
[/list]
[b]VSync[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve fixed VSync, frame pacing, and physics issues that have been experienced by some users with certain display setups, mostly when VSync is turned off.
[/list]
[b]Soft-lock[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve resolved a soft-lock issue that players would encounter when using a Roar on a rescued player vassal.
[/list]



If you do experience any issues after this Patch update, please send us any reports through to https://support.deepsilver.com/en/games/GWF or support@kochmedia.co.uk.

Thanks again for all your support and feedback in helping us improve your Gods Will Fall experience!

notes.title: Gods Will Fall - Pre-order Item Hotfix
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience!

We've resolved issues where the Hunter's Head Gear items, through pre-order of the Standard or Valiant editions weren't applying in-game. 

These items will now be assigned randomly to your warriors at each new game play-through.

notes.title: Official Gameplay trailer, Pre-Order Bonus & Valiant Edition revealed
notes.content:
Prepare yourself to take on the most legendary of challenges!

We are incredibly proud to show you the first Official Gameplay Trailer for Gods Will Fall and give you more details around the pre-order Hunter’s Head Gear and the Valiant Edition.

The gods’ rule over humanity has lasted for millennia. They demand to be worshipped by every man, woman and child. To those who don’t submit to the gods’ will; merciless death awaits.

Experience the trials of 8 Celtic warriors in their plight to sever the gods’ grip on humanity. Every man and woman who can muster a blade will form your clan and take on legions of beasts in each of the gods’ realms.

A tale emerges with every decision. Succeed and see legends born. Fail, and lives turn to dust.

[previewyoutube=hVT1sIzcnTU;full][/previewyoutube]
Gods Will Fall Standard & Valiant Editions are both available to pre-order now on Microsoft Store, Steam and Epic Games Store through godswillfall.com/pre-order, with PlayStation Store, Nintendo eShop and Stadia platforms offering a Launch Day edition from January 29th 2021.

We’ve been thrilled to see our growing community’s anticipation increase with every god we’ve announced and realm we’ve shown off. We’ve seen a lot of enthusiastic talk around the versatile combat in Gods Will Fall and our Pre-order bonus item and Valiant Edition serve to enhance your arsenal of weapons and armour and offer you an even great challenge to overcome!

Venture into each god’s bespoke and perilous realm and slay relentless swarms of minion hordes. Your clan are made up of every size and with every battle won, each shall rise through the ranks with their own exclusive weapon types, skills and items.

[h1]Pre-Order Bonus Item[/h1]

[h2]Hunter's Head Gear[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206104/e7720702492db6e5ebb038f1f1b83fd33bf8db64.jpg[/img]
The thrill of the hunt runs through the blood of the clan and it is ritual for the trophies seized to be worn proudly and displayed for all to take notice. 
The hides of 5 exclusive beasts; a wolf, bear, boar, fox, and badger are fit to be worn by any warrior and shall act as an emblazoned warning to the gods that the hunt is indeed on. The Hunter's Head Gear is assigned at random in each new game playthrough.

[h2]Valiant Edition[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206104/d43b38f555d58a1e93288da13b55bf30e4237faa.jpg[/img]
The Gods Will Fall: Valiant Edition includes the Hunter’s Head Gear and Valley of the Dormant Gods DLC extras:

The content will be released episodically as three new levels within the game in the coming months post-launch. Each level will include a new God, alongside the other bonus content.

[h3]3 New Gods:[/h3] Enter and battle your way through three new infernal god realms. Each of these uncharted hellscapes, inhabited by abominable swarms of minions will be a gruelling test to your mettle.

[h3]New Weapon Classes:[/h3] Play as two new barbarous warrior types, each with their own unique death-dealing style of combat.

[h3]New Items:[/h3] A windfall of new gear and provisions to aid your clan in battle and turn the tides of war.

[h3]New Skills:[/h3] New methods of melee to further expand you warriors’ combat system and ensure the apt champion is chosen for the battle that lies ahead.

[h3]Overworld Extras:[/h3] As you traverse the tranquil overworld, keep your eyes peeled and unearth the hidden secrets now spread across this serene landscape.

[h3]Warriors Garb:[/h3] Suit up your clan in the finest battle-ready attire & headgear for extra swagger as they enter the fray.

For more information on Gods Will Fall follow us on, [url=https://www.facebook.com/GodsWillFallGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Gods_Will_Fall]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/godswillfallgame/]Instagram[/url], or visit our [url=https://godswillfall.com/]website[/url] to sign-up to our newsletter.
